capabilities: Save the current note as a remote draft or publish it
Sync a linked note between the vault and Mails Blog
Upload vault images and replace local embeds with blog-hosted Markdown
View saved version history for a linked post
Write blog binding metadata back into frontmatter
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; token generation requires the Mails iOS app; more implementation details are in AI_HANDOFF.md rather than the README.
problem: Publishing a note to Mails Blog requires leaving Obsidian to copy content and upload images manually.
summary: Publishing plugin that drafts, publishes, syncs notes, uploads images, and writes blog metadata back to frontmatter for Mails Blog.
